items.title: We're Hiring! Interaction Designer @ NYC Planning Labs
items.description: NYC Planning Labs seeks an Interaction Designer to enhance the Department of City Planning's digital offerings by prioritizing user needs and leveraging agile methodologies.

items.title: Designing for CEQR App
items.description: An Interaction Designer describes creating tools for NYC's Environmental Quality Review process, automating analysis across 19 technical chapters through modern web design practices.

items.title: Improving Our Population FactFinder Data Pipeline
items.description: Planning Labs improved data management by automating Census data processing through PostgreSQL Foreign Data Wrappers, eliminating manual steps and enabling faster quality control.

items.title: Job: Product Manager
items.description: NYC Planning Labs recruited a Product Manager to guide cross-functional teams delivering user-centered products using agile methodologies and modern development practices.

items.title: UX on the 30th Floor, 8 Months with Planning Labs and NYC's Department of City Planning
items.description: A designer reflects on civic tech work at NYC Planning Labs, emphasizing user research, collaborative design, and the rewarding nature of solving public sector challenges.

items.title: NYC Planning Labs is hiring a Senior Full-Stack Developer!
items.description: Planning Labs sought an experienced full-stack developer to build geospatial applications using modern web frameworks, supporting urban planning innovation within city government.

items.title: Retrying Flaky Data Requests
items.description: An engineer describes implementing retry logic for rate-limited API calls in an Ember.js application using the ember-concurrency-retryable addon.

items.title: DevOps and Security on a Small Team
items.description: A consultant documents improving DevOps and security practices at Planning Labs through prioritization, configuration management with Ansible, and establishing operational procedures.

items.title: Applicant Maps, our newest product
items.description: Planning Labs launched Applicant Maps to enable applicants to self-service produce required zoning maps and reduce staff review time through guided workflows and automated validation.
